_comment: Fill this in for YOUR deployment before installing. An installing agent reads it first (START-HERE.md): blank values mean this package has not been set up for an institution yet, and the agent walks you through doing so. Nothing here is secret.
client_file_source_note: Create your own OAuth client once, following GOOGLE-CLOUD-SETUP.md, then hand the resulting ga-mcp-client.json to each person directly (password manager, shared drive your team controls, or in person), never over a chat channel or a mailing list. If your audience is External (Testing), add each person's Google account as a test user before they install.
